messages:
Maria Chen: short standup — what I did / blockers / today
Maria Chen: done rolling back the bad route change from last night, validated traffic split, fixed a docs link. Blocker: need one more eyeball on rate-limit config before canary. Today: finish canary and open the PR for the auth header change.
Tyler Nguyen: saw the rollback, thanks. quick Q — what's the intended per-minute for the new route?
Maria Chen: target is 1200/min for the frontend route, 3000/min for internal batch. planning to set separate policies by route.
Sasha Patel: heads up — the auth changes depend on the new JWT rotation lib. integration tests failing in staging because the cookie path changed.
Kai Robinson: I can take the cookie path fix, should be a 15-min patch. ping me where the failing test is.
Maria Chen: failing test link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4983/tests/22 — it's the session_refresh flow. @Kai Robinson thanks.
Tyler Nguyen: also flagging that the new rate-limit YAML has an indent mismatch in one env, saw it in the deploy logs:
```
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    auth: jwt
    rate_limit:
      per_minute: 1200
```
Tyler Nguyen: if that loses indent it becomes a list under rate_limit and the engine ignores it. small lint will catch.
Sasha Patel: adding to that — JWT TTL in the config is 3600 on staging but 1800 in prod. is that intentional?
Maria Chen: not intentional. prod should match staging (3600). I'll open a quick PR to sync.
Maria Chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/1629 (draft) — includes cookie path fix and rate-limit lint.
deploy-bot: Build #4983 — Staging tests: failing — session_refresh_spec — see details: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4983
Kai Robinson: grabbing the branch now, will push a fix and run local tests. canary window ok today between 13:00-14:00 PT?
Tyler Nguyen: 13:00-14:00 PT works for me. I'll stand by to watch metrics and bump quota if we see token queueing.
Sasha Patel: if we flip the canary, we should gate by auth success rate >99.5% for 10m and p50 latency < 100ms.
Maria Chen: agreed. will add those as canary guards in the rollout plan.
Kai Robinson: pushed fix, test pass locally. small change: cookie path set to `/` instead of `/api`.
Maria Chen: nice — can you add a note to the PR description about the cookie path rationale? makes audits easier.
Kai Robinson: done. PR updated.
Tyler Nguyen: quick smoke check: `curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/health` returns 200 for me.
Maria Chen: awesome. i'll merge the PR as draft -> canary after a green staging run. leaving the final merge to 12:50 PT so we can watch the 13:00 window.
Sasha Patel: I'll monitor auth metrics and post a short update in here at canary start.
Maria Chen: thanks team. no other blockers from my side. :thumbsup:
Tyler Nguyen: lgtm — ping me 5m before canary and i'll open the throttle window.
deploy-bot: Staging build #4987 — all tests passed.
Maria Chen: thanks deploy-bot. final note: filing a quick follow-up task to add the YAML linter rule so this indent issue is caught pre-commit.
Kai Robinson: sweet. grabbing the handoff.
Sasha Patel: copying the canary checklist here for visibility: 1) auth success >99.5% 2) p50 latency <100ms 3) error rate <0.1% 4) no increase in queue depth. will update after first 5m.
Maria Chen: perfect. done for now.
Tyler Nguyen: thanks all.
